description: markitdown is a modular data ingestion pipeline designed to transform diverse file formats into LLM-ready Markdown using a Registry-Dispatch pattern. A central orchestrator manages specialized converters that process local documents, media via AI services, and complex structures like math or tables, ensuring a standardized output format.

components.name: Orchestration & Routing
components.description: Acts as the primary interface and control plane, handling input normalization and dispatching tasks to specialized converters.

components.name: Core Orchestrator (MarkItDown)
components.description: The central hub that manages the conversion lifecycle. It maintains a registry of converters, performs input normalization (handling streams and charsets), and implements the routing logic to dispatch tasks to the appropriate converter based on file extension or MIME type.

components.name: Interface & Extension Layer
components.description: Handles the external boundaries of the subsystem. It includes the CLI entry point for user interaction and the plugin discovery mechanism that dynamically extends the orchestrator's capabilities at runtime using entry points.

components.name: Conversion Strategy Implementations
components.description: The "leaf nodes" of the orchestration tree. These are the specialized workers that implement the DocumentConverter interface. While the orchestrator routes the data, these components perform the actual format-specific parsing (e.g., CSV to Markdown).

components.name: Conversion Schema & Base Logic
components.description: Defines fundamental contracts and data structures, ensuring standardized output across all converter types.

components.name: Core Conversion Framework
components.description: Defines the fundamental abstract base classes and data models that enforce consistency across the entire library, acting as the contract layer for all specific converters.

components.name: Semantic Web & Feed Parsers
components.description: Specialized implementations that handle complex, nested HTML and XML structures, focusing on extracting semantic meaning from web-native formats.

components.name: Structured Data Translators
components.description: Handles non-HTML structured formats that require specific parsing logic to maintain hierarchical relationships, such as Jupyter Notebooks or YAML.

components.name: Document & Office Processing
components.description: The core engine for parsing binary and XML-based document formats like Word, PowerPoint, and PDF.

components.name: Office Document Converters
components.description: Handles the extraction of text and structure from Microsoft Office formats (Word, Excel) and Outlook messages. It focuses on mapping XML-based styles and tabular data into Markdown equivalents using specialized parsers like mammoth and openpyxl.

components.name: Presentation & Visual Engine
components.description: Manages the hierarchical extraction of content from PowerPoint presentations. It performs spatial analysis of shapes, slides, and notes, and integrates with LLM services to generate descriptive captions for embedded images and charts.

components.name: PDF & Fixed-Layout Processor
components.description: A specialized parser for PDF files that reconstructs logical document flow from coordinate-based text fragments. It includes sophisticated logic for merging partial lines, identifying form fields, and reconstructing tables from raw word positions.

components.name: Cloud-Native Intelligence Adapter
components.description: Provides a high-fidelity alternative to local parsing by offloading document analysis to Azure AI Document Intelligence. This is used for complex layouts where local heuristic-based parsing may fall short.

components.name: Specialized Extraction Utilities
components.description: Provides low-level logic for handling non-trivial elements like math formulas and PDF table reconstruction.

components.name: Docx Math Transformation Engine
components.description: Orchestrates the identification and conversion of Office Math Markup Language (OMML) within Word documents. It scans the document XML structure, isolates mathematical blocks, and delegates the translation to a recursive visitor-based LaTeX engine.

components.name: PDF Spatial Table Extractor
components.description: Reconstructs logical table structures from raw PDF text fragments. It uses spatial heuristics to map text coordinates into a grid-based representation and subsequently serializes that grid into a standard Markdown table format.

components.name: AI & External Service Adapters
components.description: Manages integrations with external APIs for cloud document intelligence, audio transcription, and YouTube scraping.

components.name: Cloud Document Intelligence Adapter
components.description: Interfaces with Azure AI Document Intelligence to process complex PDFs and images. It handles the full lifecycle of remote document analysis, including uploading streams, polling for completion, and mapping the service's JSON layout response to semantic Markdown.

components.name: Multimedia & Speech Processor
components.description: Manages the conversion of audio and visual media into text. It utilizes speech-to-text models (like Whisper) for audio transcription and Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) for generating descriptive captions for images and video frames.

components.name: Web Content Extractor
components.description: A specialized adapter for extracting content from external web platforms, specifically YouTube. It handles URL parsing, metadata scraping, and the retrieval of generated or manual transcripts to represent video content as text.

components.name: Vision-AI OCR Engine
components.description: Provides high-fidelity text extraction from images and documents using Vision-based LLMs. This component defines the service interface for multimodal OCR and provides specialized document converters that fallback to AI vision when standard parsing fails.

components.name: Vision & OCR Enhancement
components.description: An optional layer that adds computer vision and OCR capabilities to extract text from visual elements in documents.

components.name: OCR Service Engine
components.description: The central abstraction layer that manages the interaction with LLM vision models, converting raw image data into text descriptions or OCR results.

components.name: OCR-Enabled Document Converters
components.description: A collection of format-specific converters (PDF, PPTX, XLSX, DOCX) that identify visual elements and delegate text extraction to the OCR Service Engine.

components.name: OCR Plugin Integrator
components.description: Manages the registration and discovery of OCR-enhanced converters, ensuring they take precedence when the OCR plugin is active.
